mutations.name: fr7-docs-warning-lines
mutations._mechanism: Remove the requirement to carry every Phase-7 warning and its three warning codes.
mutations.find: Carry every `WARNING` line into the Phase-7 report, including `review_non_independent`, `review_independence_unrecorded` and `review_independence_malformed`; warnings do not change readiness.

mutations.name: fr7-docs-review-append
mutations._mechanism: Remove the instruction to append review independence after each review leg for every implementer.
mutations.find: After each 5e-review, 5e-verify and 6a-prime leg, run `h_mad_state_write.py docs/.bkit-memory.json --feature <feature> --session-id <owner-session-id> --append review_independence='{"leg":"<leg>","module":"<module>","reviewer":"<reviewer>","implementer":"<implementer>","independent":false}'` for every implementer, applying the attribution rule below and replacing the example boolean with the computed value: `independent` is `reviewer != implementer`.

mutations.name: fr7-docs-dispatch-source
mutations._mechanism: Remove the accepted dispatch as the implementer source and the prohibition on routing-field attribution.
mutations.find: `implementer` is read from the dispatch that authored the reviewed code, never read from `implementer_switch.to` or from the `implementer` field, which describe routing.

mutations.name: fr7-docs-5e-author-append
mutations._mechanism: Remove the accepted GREEN author append before spec review.
mutations.find: **Record authors before review:** when the orchestrator accepts a module's GREEN dispatch (reads `STATUS: DONE` or `STATUS: DONE_WITH_CONCERNS` and stops re-dispatching GREEN), run `h_mad_state_write.py docs/.bkit-memory.json --feature <feature> --session-id <owner-session-id> --append implementation_authors='{"module":"<module>","agent":"<agent>"}'` before the module's 5e spec-review leg runs.

mutations.name: fr7-docs-6a-prime-author-append
mutations._mechanism: Remove the accepted WITH_FIXES author append before the next review.
mutations.find: **After `WITH_FIXES`:** for each accepted fix dispatch, run `h_mad_state_write.py docs/.bkit-memory.json --feature <feature> --session-id <owner-session-id> --append implementation_authors='{"module":"<module>","agent":"<agent>"}'` before the next leg that reviews the fixed code.

mutations.name: fr7-docs-transcription-words
mutations._mechanism: Remove the durable author field as the only author-set source, breaking the transcription's tie to the procedure.
mutations.find: The author set is read from `implementation_authors` only, never from earlier `review_independence` entries or an in-context dispatch list.
